debug.description: Enable debug logging. Set to `true` to increase verbosity for troubleshooting.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging. Provides more detailed log output than info level.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

log_file.description: Name of the main log file for the polling agent.

transport_url.description: OSLO Messaging transport URL for connecting to the message broker (e.g., RabbitMQ).

project_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service project (used in Keystone v3).

user_domain_name.description: Domain name for the service user (used in Keystone v3).

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name used for Ceilometer service authentication.

username.description: Service user name for Ceilometer to authenticate against Keystone.

password.description: Password for the Ceilometer service user. Leave empty unless configured.

www_authenticate_uri.description: Public endpoint used by clients to authenticate (often same as auth_url without path).

auth_type.description: Authentication method; typically `password` for service accounts.

polling_namespaces.description: List of polling namespaces to enable. Each namespace corresponds to a source group (e.g., `compute` for nova, `ipmi` for IPMI polling).

polling_sources.description: List of named polling sources. Each source defines meters to collect, interval, and optional discovery rules.

name.description: Name of the polling source (matches one of the entries in `polling_namespaces`).

meter.description: List of meter names to collect from this source. Empty = all meters enabled for the source.

interval.description: Polling interval in seconds for this source.

disabled.description: Set to `true` to disable polling for this source.

resource_types.description: List of resource types (e.g., instances, volumes) to poll. Leave empty to poll all.

resource_discovery.description: Enable automatic discovery of resources (e.g., dynamic instance discovery).

discovery_params.description: Key-value pairs passed as discovery parameters (e.g., project_id, region_name).

resources.description: Static list of resources to poll (e.g., instance IDs or hostnames).

region_name.description: Keystone region name for Gnocchi/telemetry service endpoint.

endpoint_type.description: Endpoint type used to connect to Gnocchi (e.g., `publicURL`, `internalURL`, `adminURL`).

archive_policy.description: Name of the Gnocchi archive policy used for meters not matched by default.

namespace.description: Gnocchi resource type namespace prefix (e.g., `openstack` for `openstack.instance`).

resource_type.description: Base resource type to use when creating metrics in Gnocchi (e.g., `instance`, `volume`, `generic`).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for requests to Gnocchi API.
